scope: Registered molecular atlas lanes and a minimum graph-ready schema; this is not a complete schema for every source-specific table.

identity.rule: Source identifiers are scoped to their authority; never join on a bare mag_id or label across lanes. Preserve crosswalk status and source row provenance.

pipeline_normalized.meaning: Selected curated MAG/bin attempts and long-form tool events under a shared warehouse shape; cross-lane mechanism equivalence remains unproven.

source_scaffold.meaning: Source DRAM, RNA expression, sample metadata, environmental observations and exploratory network evidence. Scores are not numerically interchangeable with pipeline-normalized mechanism features.

status_semantics.registered_gap: Retain the registered identity, reason, status and next action; never convert a missing payload to a biological zero.
status_semantics.failed_or_partial_attempt: Keep the run or source row and its failure state even when a completed attempt is selected for a feature table.
status_semantics.observed_no_hit: Only a completed, covered tool run can support a method-specific no-hit; it is not proof of biological absence.
status_semantics.sample_linked_units_zero: No release-authorized ecological sample linkage for MRV scoring; sequencing-sample expression and staged field metadata may still exist.
status_semantics.field_validated_units_zero: No field-validated molecular-to-flux inference in the release; it does not mean no field observations are staged.

tables.grain: one registered molecular unit per atlas lane
tables.null_semantics: Explicit excluded and gap rows remain in the frozen denominator; blank ecological links are unresolved, not zero.
tables.claim_scope: Molecular payload availability and review priority only.

tables.null_semantics: Missing from the selected dimension may mean failed, partial, excluded, or assembly-context; resolve through source manifest and run-status rows.

tables.grain: one inspected curation attempt per MAG and run
tables.null_semantics: Retain failed, partial, superseded and non-comparable attempts; do not project missing runs into a zero-hit fact.

tables.grain: one annotation tool per selected MAG
tables.null_semantics: Inspect tool coverage before interpreting absence of sparse annotation hits.

tables.grain: one molecular screening feature row per selected MAG
tables.null_semantics: An unobserved feature is not measured zero methane activity.
tables.claim_scope: MAG-level screening; no sample or project risk tier.

tables.null_semantics: The 2,508-record source roster includes seven release ESM-2 exclusions; source scope and payload scope differ.
tables.claim_scope: Source-scaffold molecular reference and explicit gaps.

tables.grain: MAG by processed sequencing sample expression observation
tables.measurement_type: RNA expression detection or magnitude under source processing
tables.null_semantics: No expression row is not DNA absence or a field sample–flux pair.
Missing flux value or non-exact molecular join remains unresolved; do not infer a zero or attach to a MAG.
tables.claim_scope: Source environmental observation, not validated molecular-to-flux attribution.

tables.null_semantics: Use the typed tower source with its time/value fields; the August generic process table has a known blank-value/date mapping defect.
tables.claim_scope: Source environmental time series; no direct molecular attribution.

tables.null_semantics: Porewater concentration is not chamber or tower methane flux; absent exact sample links remain explicit.

graph_projection.entity_id_rule: Namespaced authority plus source ID; molecular entities use lane_id:proteome_id and attempts additionally use cohort_run_id:run_id.
graph_projection.rule: Store edge evidence, provenance, status and uncertainty; similarity and ambiguous crosswalks do not assert causal transfer, ecological process, or exact sample identity.

unresolved_schema_gates: Declare and duplicate-audit stable keys for pipeline fact_input_stats, fact_dbcan_hits, fact_bakta_features and run_summary_metrics.
Audit primary keys and exact entity relationships across all 61 MUCC source-scaffold tables before a physical schema migration.
Add versioned source-accession, license/access, tool/database fingerprint, units and transformation provenance fields to a future portable catalog.
Rebuild the generic August process table in a new dated output after the tower mapping repair and validate modality-specific value/date completeness.
